content.title: Colombia blasts Ecuador's pipeline fee hike as trade war between neighbors escalates
content.summary: Colombia on Tuesday blasted Ecuador’s decision to hike up transportation fees for Colombian oil, calling the move an act of “aggression,” as a trade war between the two Andean nations intensifies.  Ecuador announced Monday a tenfold increase in fees for Colombian companies using its oil pipelines, raising the rate from $3 to $30 per barrel.  The move would make it harder for oil companies in Colombia to use a pipeline that takes oil from western Ecuador and southwestern Colombia to ports along the Pacific Ocean.
